fields.acceptance: internal/api ship tests with a fake gh: open-pr, check and check --settled each refuse an open or merged PR whose body names another change set, and one whose body has no 'Change set' line, and leave ship state unwritten (open-pr also neither pulls the foreign PR's commits in nor pushes onto it); a PR whose body names the run's change set is tracked as before
fields.statement: Ship open-pr and ship check (with and without --settled, which the workflows' wait-pr steps run), the ops that look a pull request up by branch, refuse a pull request on the change set's branch, open, merged or closed, unless its body's 'Change set <id>' line names the run's change set (a PR naming another change set or with no such line is refused), with a conflict naming that PR, before open-pr fetches, follows or pushes the branch, and never write it to ship state
